about: Band 05 of every state blueprint, Perfect Nations Intelligence: the AI programmes already running in other states’ agencies, the three tests a programme must pass to appear, and the sources for the SNAP payment error rates and the cost shift. Each state file keeps its own bill and advice under "intelligence". Read by tools/build_us_state.py.

proven.name: Nevada
proven.line: chose SAS in June 2026 to check every active SNAP case with AI and flag the ones most likely to be paid wrongly, before the money goes out.

proven.name: Michigan
proven.line: reviewed 17,500 SNAP payments in three months with an AI case-reading tool before they were issued; the ACLU of Michigan has since asked for its records.

tests: An AI programme appears here only if it moves one of the seven basic standards, already runs in a U.S. state or city agency with a published result, and corrects errors in both directions, so that no eligible family is cut off. Perfect Nations is vendor-neutral: it advises on tools and never resells them.
